pattern.description: Two-line headline rises in from below onto a blank off-white card, line 1 leading and line 2 following a couple of frames later, settling in about 0.35 s.
pattern.why_premium: Tight line-level stagger with a fast ease-out settle gives the type a confident, editorial entrance without any decoration; the motion stops dead before the line is read.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.headline .line', {yPercent: 60, opacity: 0}, {yPercent: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out', stagger: 0.06})
build_hint.remotion: Per line i: const p = spring({frame: frame - i*2, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 180, mass: 1}}); translateY = interpolate(p, [0,1], [40,0]); opacity = p.

notes: OCR reads 'Al'; text set to 'AI' as visible. Line vs word unit inferred from filmstrip (lines move as blocks; line 2 lags line 1). Whether a line mask clips the rise is not clear at this resolution.
